Package service

Class RentalService

java.lang.Object
service.RentalService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subject
public class RentalService extends Object implements Subject
Service class responsible for managing vehicle rental operations.

This class provides the core business logic for the Vehicle Rental Management System. It handles the rental process, validates rental requests, updates vehicle availability, stores rental records, and notifies registered observers when rental events occur.

The class also implements the Observer design pattern through the Subject interface, allowing notification services to be informed whenever a vehicle is successfully rented.

  • Method Details

    • rentVehicle

      public Rental rentVehicle(Customer customer, Vehicle vehicle, LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate)
      Creates a new rental after validating the rental request.

      This method performs the following operations:

      • Checks whether the selected vehicle is available.
      • Validates the rental period.
      • Validates type-specific rental rules using Strategy Pattern.
      • Creates a new rental record.
      • Updates the vehicle status to RENTED.
      • Saves the rental in the repository.
      • Notifies all registered observers.
      Parameters:
      customer - the customer renting the vehicle
      vehicle - the vehicle to be rented
      startDate - the rental start date
      endDate - the rental end date
      Returns:
      the created Rental object
      Throws:
      VehicleNotAvailableException - if the selected vehicle is already rented
      InvalidRentalPeriodException - if the rental period is invalid
      IllegalArgumentException - if type-specific validation fails
